messages.subject: Central Pattana | Sustainable urban growth, partnerships and institutional strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Uahwatanasakul,

Your 2026 leadership agenda for Central Pattana, centered on sustainable urban development, future cities and long-term value creation, strongly resonates with my experience in stakeholder-led development.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy. I work across ministries, regulators, communities, business partners and internal operating teams to move complex investment and development priorities forward.

My value lies in connecting growth with institutional trust. I have led multi-agency engagement, community and social-performance coordination, sustainability governance, formal executive communications and cross-functional delivery in a heavily regulated environment. I also bring energy-transition and carbon-governance experience that strengthens my perspective on resilient and sustainable development.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or executive stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Central Pattana-focused executive CV for your review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
